text:
lara_cs: Quick summary from StoneHaven's dry-connect earlier. Collecting the few outstanding blockers so the cutover stays on schedule.

tony_customer: Thanks, Lara. Biggest concern is KMS rotations during our procurement freeze window—can't accept any key state changes while we transition.

lara_cs: We can add a no-rotation window. Josh/Rachel, can you propose a freeze and update the runbook? Also need confirmation on how audit logs will stream to their SIEM.

josh_netops: Proposed KMS freeze: 2026-04-20T08:00Z -> 2026-04-22T08:00Z (48h). Will mark runbook 'no-rotation' and add explicit ack step. Tony, good for you?

tony_customer: Yes. 48h freeze OK. We'll block any scheduled key operations.

rachel_sre: On logging: prefer Kinesis Firehose to S3 for lower-latency delivery to customer SIEM. Retention requirement they stated is 400 days. Need customer's KMS key ARN for encryption on the Firehose delivery stream.

tony_customer: We can provide the key ARN and a constrained key policy. Note: compliance team insists on customer-managed key, no cross-account grants unless explicitly scoped.

josh_netops: We will accept customer-managed key. Required policy snippet to grant Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey plus CreateGrant so Firehose can use the key to write: (scope Principal to redwood-service role).

rachel_sre: Sample policy to paste into their KMS key policy:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-service"},
      "Action": [
        "kms:Encrypt",
        "kms:Decrypt",
        "kms:GenerateDataKey*",
        "kms:CreateGrant",
        "kms:DescribeKey"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

josh_netops: Network note: StoneHaven uses transit-gateway attachments (not peering). We saw blocked flows from their egress block — they need to propagate 172.31.128.0/20 into TGW route table and allow outbound to redwood mgmt on 443 and 8443. During setup they'll open 22 temporarily; we'll close after provisioning.

tony_customer: Confirming: egress block 172.31.128.0/20, ports 443 & 8443 runtime, 22 for provisioning only.

rachel_sre: Also ask: do they require source NAT? If yes, we need the public egress IPs for allowlist. If they're SNATing via NAT gateway, put the NAT elastic IPs here.

tony_customer: They will SNAT through two NAT EIPs: 3.14.159.26 and 3.14.159.27. Sharing in DM.

DeployBot: Runbook updated: added KMS freeze window, Firehose delivery config draft, TGW route reminder, provisioning port note. Open items: customer KMS ARN, NAT EIP confirmation, SIEM ingest endpoint. Status: in-progress.

lara_cs: Renewal watch: procurement mentioned a 'finance hold' risk if billing term not clarified. If cutover slips beyond 10 business days notify AM. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth.

tony_customer: We'll push the key ARN and SIEM endpoint by EOD. Appreciate the focus.

rachel_sre: Action items: (1) Josh to validate TGW route propagation (ETA 3h), (2) Tony to post KMS ARN + SIEM endpoint (ETA EOD), (3) Lara to flag renewal watch to AM if timeline slips. I'll wire up Firehose once ARN is in hand.

josh_netops: Starting TGW checks now. Will post route table snapshots when done.

tony_customer: DMing NAT EIPs and SIEM contact. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

lara_cs: Great, next sync tomorrow 08:30 PT or earlier if any blocker crops up.
